items.briefing:
Many Australian businesses are rolling out AI tools faster than they're putting rules and oversight in place to manage them safely — raising real risks around data handling and accountability. Separately, AI is increasingly being used to detect mortgage fraud, a timely reminder that financial scams continue to evolve and target everyday Australians.

Online scams also remain rampant, with reports of relentless waves of fraudulent websites and emails targeting users. If your organisation uses AI tools for any purpose, make sure there's a clear policy on what data staff can enter into them — especially anything sensitive or client-related.

featured.title: AI is the new battleground in mortgage fraud detection
featured.quote: AI-generated fake payslips and deepfakes are undermining mortgage lender fraud detection systems across Australia.
